verdict.rationale: Loops documents a visual editor and lets external coding agents create draft campaigns and content through the Content API, MCP, and skills. None of the evidence shows a built-in AI assistant inside the composer that drafts or refines subject lines or copy from a brief. Agent-driven authoring through the API is an external, adjacent capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can have the platform's built-in AI draft or refine subject lines and email copy from a brief, inside the composer
